newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to speak to Solana by telephone-Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to speak to Solana by telephone-Interfax.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will speak to NATO Secretary General Javier Solana by telephone on Wednesday, Interfax news agency quoted the Kremlin as saying.
Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky gave no details. Solana was holding talks with Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov in Moscow on a deal about relations between NATO and Russia.
The Kremlin said before Solana and Primakov began their talks on Tuesday that Yeltsin had no plans to meet the NATO leader but might speak to him by telephone.
Yeltsin called U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright earlier this month when she was having talks in Moscow with Primakov about relations between NATO and Russia.
Primakov and Solana were holding an unscheduled second day of talks to try to finalise a partnership pact between Moscow and the Western defence alliance after six hours of talks on Tuesday.

They were trying to resolve differences over the terns of the planned document, which is intended to forge a peaceful relationship into the next century and address Russian fears over NATO's eastward expansion.
